messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — Acme just pinged saying three new internal teams will start sending traffic next week. They expect ~3x current qps for embeddings and a bunch of realtime summarization jobs.
acme_pm: Yep — sorry for the late notice. New teams: support (summaries), analytics (embeddings), ops (realtime alerts). Target go-live: next Wed. Estimated load: `~45k embeds/day` and `peak 120 qps` for short sequences.
maria_cs: Ok that's a meaningful bump. Jonah, heads-up for renewal / quota planning — they're on a mid-tier committed plan, renewal in 6w.
jonah_am: Noted. Renewal timeline + spike could be a risk if we don't offer path to keep latency stable. Can we propose Dedicated pilot or burst capacity?
devin_se: Technical Qs: are these teams all in same region? what's avg seq len and percent streaming? Also do they plan cross-request caching? If seq len <=512, we can use the `q8_0` quantized variant and keep latency under 250ms.
acme_pm: Mostly us-east workers. Sequence len: support ~200 tokens, analytics embedding payloads small, ops realtime <64 tokens and heavy streaming.
maria_cs: Action items: 1) Devin, can you validate model choices + rough cost delta for Dedicated vs hosted burst? 2) Jonah, prep renewal cadence note offering pilot + discount if they commit to a 3-month reserved pool. 3) I'll schedule a 45m enablement to onboard their infra team.
devin_se: I'll run perf sim today. Need sample payloads — @acme_pm can you drop a sanitized example here or in the S3 link? `s3://acme-redwood/samples` works.
acme_pm: uploading now. ETA 30m.
provision-bot: quota change request #Q-17892 created by maria_cs — 100k tokens/day provisional increase. Status: pending review.
jonah_am: Also flagging product: if they want deterministic latency we should land a canary on dedicated GPUs and pre-warm KV caches before go-live. Sylvia from product ok to join if needed.
maria_cs: Sylvia — pinging you for product ops alignment — short sync later today?
acme_pm: Uploaded sample payloads (link: https://s3.amazon.com/.../acme-samples.zip). Let me know if you need more.
devin_se: Got samples. Running a 24h throughput sim against current model variants. Preliminary: hosted costs spike ~2.8x, Dedicated pilot looks ~1.6x cheaper for steady load.
jonah_am: Good, that number is saleable. I'll draft the pilot proposal + 10% pilot discount. Maria, can you confirm enablement timeslot tomorrow 10am PT?
maria_cs: Confirmed. I'll send the invite and attach the playbook: `/docs/onboarding/enablement_playbook_v2.md`.
provision-bot: quota request #Q-17892 approved by infra on 1748123600. Provisioning scheduled.
acme_pm: Amazing — appreciate the fast turnaround :tada:
maria_cs: Great teamwork. I'll post a short recap + next steps in Salesforce and link the pilot doc. If anything changes before the 10am session, ping here.
jonah_am: Adding renewal flag in CRM (medium risk -> mitigated by pilot). Will follow up with contract template once pilot terms are finalized.
devin_se: Adding perf notes to the ticket. If caching hits are low we'll need to tune batching.
maria_cs: Closing thread for now — will reopen if more upstream changes. Thanks everyone!
